title: Luscious Smoky Ukrainian Beef Borscht
description: Hearty weeknight borscht featuring smoky beef broth and crispy bacon, served in a bento box for a fun twist on the classic Ukrainian dish.
instructions: Brown the bacon in a large stock pot over medium heat, then set it aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Add the ground beef to the pot and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, and beets to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef bones, water, and browned bacon back to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Add the beet juice, Korean chili flakes, and vegetable oil to the pot and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the borscht hot, garnished with fresh dill and a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkle of chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Assemble the bento boxes by dividing the borscht among four small containers, adding a sprinkle of crispy bacon and a few fresh herbs to each.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
Reheat the borscht before serving, and garnish with additional fresh herbs and crispy bacon, if desired.
